chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hajjal, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to eat the cucumbers with the salt.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet eat with cucumbers according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kulayni’s *Al-Kafi* under the chapter on Cucumbers, this hadith highlights the Sunnah of consuming cucumbers with salt, a practice often cited by Shia jurists to discuss the food's cooling nature and its balance with other dietary elements. It underscores the Prophet’s (peace be upon him and his family) attention to both the taste and health benefits of common vegetables, reflecting the practical wisdom embedded in prophetic dietary guidelines.
